The '''Maldrood Oversector''', also known as '''Sector 12''' or '''Greater Maldrood Sector''', was the theater of operations of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was reorganized in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oversector/Legends|Priority Sector]] and placed under the rule of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Therbon/Legends|Therbon]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="EGTW5">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22128732052/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-5|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 5}}</ref>

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the area of operations of the aged Grand Moff Therbon still included [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]]. After the [[Calamarian Revolt]], Therbon grew frustrated with his inability to retake [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and finally ordered the [[Bombardment of Ruisto|bombardment]] of [[Ruisto]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="SOR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Greater Maldrood Sector was ruled by the Grand Moff [[Ambris Selit]]. After the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the fragmentation of the Empire, [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] put Grand Moff Selit under house arrest and took control of the Greater Maldrood. The oversector would become the basis of the territory of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] Teradoc's [[Greater Maldrood|splinter faction]].<ref name="Despoilers">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
